description: Implementation of the AttachedSources class managing media source attachments with thread safety, including methods to add, remove, and retrieve media sources by ID.

classes.name: AttachedSources
classes.description: A class that manages attached media sources, allowing addition, removal, and retrieval of sources by ID with thread safety.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a media source with a specific ID and type to the collection.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a media source by its ID from the collection.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the media source type associated with a given ID, returns UNKNOWN if not found.
